en.name: Sole
en.summary: Sole is a flatfish with fine, sweet, close-grained flesh in very thin fillets, and unusually among white fish it is better for a short rest rather than worse. A good deal of what is sold as sole is other flatfish; true Dover sole is a distinct fish with a tough, leathery skin. From purchase it keeps 1–2 days in the fridge and 6–8 months in the freezer.
en.pantry: None. Thin flatfish fillets carry a great deal of surface for very little weight, with almost no fat to buffer them, so they slacken within an hour or two in a warm kitchen. Home cold, and the 2-hour limit applies, or 1 hour once the day passes 32 °C (90 °F). The traditional practice of holding a whole Dover sole for a day or two before cooking is not an exception to any of this: that rest happens buried in ice in a chiller, which is a different thing entirely from a fish sitting on a worktop.
en.fridge: 1–2 days from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. A whole sole handles the wait better than fillets do, and there is a practical reason to buy it that way: the tough skin comes off in a single pull, and that job is easier after a day on ice than it is on the day of the catch. Keep the fish cold from beneath, on a rack above ice, and make sure the melt water runs away rather than pooling around it, because thin sole flesh takes up water and softens. Do not salt or season it in advance while it is stored — salt draws moisture out of a delicate fillet and you cannot put it back.
en.freezer: 6–8 months at −18 °C (0 °F), which is generous for a fish this delicate, and the reason is simply how little fat it carries: there is almost nothing in it to go rancid. What there is to lose is texture. Interleave the fillets with baking paper, exclude every pocket of air, or glaze them with a dipped layer of ice, and freeze them flat. A thin fillet dries out sooner than a thick one when the wrapping is careless, so this is a fish worth double-wrapping. Safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months describe eating quality.
en.thawing: On a plate in the fridge, a few hours at most. Sole is also one of the better fish to cook straight from frozen, in a hot pan with butter, because it is thin enough to cook through before the outside overcooks. Not on the counter, not in warm water, and not refrozen raw.
spoilage: A sour or ammoniacal smell instead of a clean, sweet one.
Flesh that stays dented when pressed rather than springing back.
A milky or sticky film on the fillet, or liquid pooling underneath.
Grey or yellowing edges, and flesh that tears when lifted.
tips: Buy whole if you are not cooking today; the frame protects the flesh.
Keep fillets on a rack, never in melt water.
Interleave fillets with paper before freezing.
Cook from frozen if you forgot to thaw — thin sole copes very well.

faq.q: How long does sole keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 1–2 days from purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, on ice and not sitting in water.
Yes, 6–8 months at −18 °C. Freeze fillets flat and airtight, with paper between them.

faq.q: Should Dover sole be rested before cooking?
faq.a: Traditionally yes, for a day or two — but on ice in a chiller, never at room temperature, and within the same fridge window.

faq.q: How can you tell if sole has gone off?
faq.a: A sour or ammoniacal smell, a milky film on the surface, or flesh that will not spring back when pressed.

zh.name: 鰨魚
zh.summary: 鰨魚是扁身魚，肉質細緻清甜、纖維綿密，魚片非常薄；而且在白肉魚裡少見地，它靜置一下反而更好而不是更差。要留意的是，市面上不少標成鰨魚的其實是別種扁魚；真正的多佛鰨是獨立的魚種，魚皮堅韌得像皮革。從購買日起冷藏可放 1～2 天，冷凍 6～8 個月。
zh.pantry: 沒有。薄的扁魚片相對於重量有極大的表面積，又幾乎沒有脂肪當緩衝，在溫暖的廚房裡一兩個小時就軟塌。請保冷帶回家，2 小時上限照樣適用，氣溫超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。整條多佛鰨傳統上會先放一兩天再煮，但那不是上述規則的例外：那是埋在冷藏櫃的冰裡靜置，和一條擱在流理臺上的魚完全是兩回事。
zh.fridge: 從購買日起放 4 °C 以下 1～2 天。整條比切片更耐等，而且買整條有一個實際的理由：那層堅韌的魚皮可以一把撕下來，而這件事在冰上放過一天之後，比剛上岸那天好做得多。請架在網架上、從底下用冰把它冰住，並確保融水是流走而不是積在魚身邊，因為薄的鰨魚肉吸了水就會軟掉。保存期間不要先調味或抹鹽——鹽會把細緻魚片裡的水拉出來，而那些水回不去了。
zh.freezer: 在 −18 °C 下 6～8 個月，對這麼細緻的魚來說算慷慨，原因很單純：它含脂極低，幾乎沒有東西可以產生油耗味。會失去的是口感。魚片之間夾烘焙紙、把每一個空氣縫都排掉，或浸冷水做一層冰衣，然後壓平冷凍。包裝一隨便，薄魚片就比厚的更快變乾，所以這是一種值得包兩層的魚。在 −18 °C 下安全性可以無限期維持，月數說的是食用品質。
zh.thawing: 放盤子上冷藏，幾小時就夠。鰨魚也是最適合直接從冷凍下鍋的魚之一：熱鍋加奶油煎，因為它夠薄，外層還沒過頭中心就熟了。不要放檯面、不要泡溫水，生魚也不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸或有氨味，而不是乾淨清甜的魚味。
按壓後凹陷回不來，而不是有彈性。
魚片表面出現乳白黏膜，或下方積水。
邊緣泛灰泛黃，拿起來就散。
tips: 今天不煮就買整條；骨架會保護魚肉。
魚片架在網架上，不要泡融水。
忘了解凍就直接下鍋——薄的鰨魚完全沒問題。

faq.a: 鋪冰、不泡水，放 4 °C 以下，從購買日起 1～2 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 6～8 個月。魚片壓平密封，中間夾紙。

faq.q: 多佛鰨要先靜置再煮嗎？
faq.a: 傳統上會靜置一兩天，但那是在冷藏櫃的冰上，絕不是室溫，而且仍在同一個冷藏期限之內。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷鰨魚不新鮮了？
faq.a: 發酸或氨味、表面乳白黏膜，或按壓沒有彈性。
